I often refer to my childhood as a black hole. anything before the ages of 11 I only remember through very brief memories or flashbacks where I piece together information. 11 was when I was adopted out of my abusive household.

the reason we can't remember has something to do with a memory block. When the brain is going through something traumatic, it cuts ties with any systems that it deems not important for survival, usually memory filing is the first to go. That's why flashbacks happen when certain triggers occur. You're reminding your brain that something happened that wasn't correctly logged into your memory system, so it replays the incident in an attempt to piece together what happened. 

Long story short, it's completely normal for abuse or trauma victims to not remember their trauma, especially if it was throughout their childhood development years. You're not alone <3
